scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.check: pnpm -r --if-present check && uv run --all-packages ruff check services
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && uv run --all-packages pytest services/api/tests services/worker/tests
